Options for the explorer

Source: R/options.R
grafts_options.Rd

Chooses which views the explorer offers, how it starts, how its data are sent and how big it is when embedded, for the options argument of grafts().

Usage

grafts_options(
  views = c("grid", "overlay", "stacked", "season"),
  additive = NULL,
  season = NULL,
  theme = c("system", "light", "dark"),
  persist = TRUE,
  max_points = 1000,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  element_id = NULL,
  title = "Graph explorer"
)

Arguments

views

The view tabs offered, in order: any of "grid", "overlay", "stacked" and "season". The first is shown at the start.

additive

Whether each series is the sum of its children. NULL detects it. When not additive, the Stacked view and the share scales are removed.

season

The seasonal period of the Season view: NULL for the automatic one (the year, where the data has one), FALSE for no Season view, or the name of one of fabletools::common_periods(data), such as "week" for daily data.

theme

The theme at first, for visitors who haven't chosen one: "system" follows their device.

persist

Whether the explorer saves the visitor's choices (tab, scales, layout and theme) in their browser. Use FALSE for a fixed starting view, such as in documentation. When TRUE, saved choices that the options don't allow fall back to the first of views and each tab's default scale.

max_points

Series more than twice this long are sent to the app as the minimum and maximum of blocks of time, about max_points values, so spikes stay visible. The season and stacked plots always get the full series, and an explorer written into a page (grafts_save(), documents and Shiny) always has the full series.

width, height

Size of the explorer when written into a page, in pixels or as a CSS length. In documents and Shiny the height defaults to 600px, and a page from grafts_save() fills the window.

element_id

An id for the explorer's element in a document.

title

The title of the page, for the browser's tab: served by grafts_serve() and grafts_api(), and written by grafts_save().

Value

A grafts_options list, for the options argument of grafts().

Details

The Stacked view and the grid's share-of-parent scale only make sense when each series is the sum of the series it splits into. With additive = NULL this is checked on data (for every split of every series, at the times where all the parts are observed), so means or other non-additive aggregates lose those options automatically.

Examples

# A grid and season plots only, always starting dark and fresh
grafts_options(views = c("grid", "season"), theme = "dark", persist = FALSE)
#> <grafts_options> views: grid, season (starting at grid)

# Weekly seasons for daily data, instead of yearly ones
grafts_options(views = c("season", "grid", "overlay"), season = "week")
#> <grafts_options> views: season, grid, overlay (starting at season)

# No Season view, and a mean-aggregated tsibble known to be non-additive
grafts_options(season = FALSE, additive = FALSE)
#> <grafts_options> views: grid, overlay, stacked, season (starting at grid)
